units: <cite ref="Nazir 36b:3">Naz. 36ᵇ</cite> <he>אי דקא שָׂרֵיף ליה מִישְׂרַף</he> if he quaffed it (swallowed it, instead of striking it on bread); <cite ref="Pesachim 44a:9">Pes. 44ᵃ</cite> <he>אי בעיניה דקשריף וקאכיל ליה</he> (Ms. M. <he>בעיניה קאכיל ליה</he>) if he swallowed it in its natural condition, opp. <he>שטר</he>.
<cite ref="Keritot 22a:26">Ker. 22ᵃ</cite> <he>בשעה … מישרף שריף</he> with the last breath of the animal, it (the heart) absorbs (the blood from the blood vessels).
<cite ref="Taanit 24b:10">Taan. 24ᵇ</cite> <he>ש׳ פינכא וכ׳</he> (Ms. M. <he>טעים מידי</he>, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note) he swallowed a dishful of grist.
<cite ref="Taanit 24b:10">Ib.</cite> <he>אי שְׂרִיף מר וכ׳</he> (v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 300) if you had swallowed &c.

<cite ref="Berakhot 62a:3">Ber. 62ᵃ</cite> <he>כדלא ש׳ תבשילא</he> as if he had never sipped a dish (never had had marital intercourse; <cite ref="Chagigah 5b:8">Ḥag. 5ᵇ</cite> <he>כמאן דלא טעים וכ׳</he>).
